R5_regret_crossfit.note: EXPLORATORY (post-registration; not part of the registered analysis)
R5_regret_crossfit.caveat: each fold's held-out logits come from a probe trained on the other folds, so selection statistics on folds != f still depend on fold-f labels through those probes. Removing that requires refitting probes in a nested design (GPU); this analysis removes the direct reuse.

rules.lowest_cka: lowest CKA with the anchor (label-free; the registered heuristic)
rules.unique: largest unique contribution over the base
rules.gated_diversity: lowest CKA among candidates within 1.5 points of the most accurate
rules.rank_sum: best sum of accuracy rank and (inverse) CKA rank; ties to accuracy
